polishes.name: Cirrus
polishes.description: Cirrus is part of our second magnetic collection, The Nephology Collection. It has a clear base and is filled with silver magnetic pigment. The perfect polish for a that beautiful velvet effect. This polish works really well as a topper to create that velvet effect over any color. Or, try putting a sheer jelly polish over it for a glass type effect. It is part of the Nephology Collection which can be found here. Nephology is the study of clouds and each of these polishes are named after cloud classifications. Cirrus clouds are wispy low altitude clouds. Application Tip: Apply thin layers and let the nail dry for 30 seconds while you keep your finger on the magnet. Repeat this for each layer, INCLUDING the top coat. Yes this takes forever but it really helps prevent those magnetic particles from settling into different directions! polishes.description: Scent Black Cardamom & Cream Scent Notes Top: Cinnamon, Peppercorn Middle: Cream, Black Cardamom, Ginger Bottom: Tonka Bean, Chestnut, Wood Ingredients Coconut Apricot Wax Blend, Fragrance Oil Size 9 oz, 5 oz Dimensions 9 oz - 3.375" Height x 3" Diameter5 oz - 2" Height x 3.5" Diameter Wick Wooden wick with medium crackle Vessel Metal All of our candles are hand poured in small batches using a coconut soy blend of wax. Coconut apricot is a natural, non-toxic, biodegradable, and renewable sustainable resource. It creates a safe and clean burn. All our products of vegan, phthalate, paraben, and cruelty free. Instructions: Trim your wick to 1/8" every time you burn. This allows a more even burn, and avoids ash or excess smoke. Always burn within sight. For the first burn, make sure to allow the melt pool to extend to the perimeter of the candle. This helps avoid tunneling. To avoid smoke put out the flame by putting on the lid. Do not burn for more than 3-4 hours at a time. Once the wax and wick have gotten down to the wick clip, do not continue to burn. Because the container is metal, it will get very hot if burning with little wax. Keep out of reach of children and animals. Keep free of foreign material including matches. Burn on level and non-flammable surfaces. Avoid burning in drafty areas. The container has a removable lid that snaps on creating a tight seal. We always suggest you repurpose the container as not all recycling plants accept steel.
